motionReport.method: Source meshes and materials retained. Rigid component transforms with independent full-path geometric verification.
motionReport.checker: Original assembly_motion VERSION15 continuous translation SAT plus 97-pose bidirectional closed-component containment checks.

assemblyFit.method: Rigid fits between matching exploded and V2 source CAD triangle correspondences; existing approved meshes and material assignments are transformed, never replaced.

motionReport.sourceLayout: Source separated layout with documented pickup-front seating gap at progress 0; V2-derived assembled pose with documented neck-seat and pickup-front clearances at progress 1.
motionReport.jointPolicy: Approach directions are checked as reverse withdrawals from original CAD joints; exact contact at the final joint is intentional.
motionReport.pickupConstruction: The two independently connected source CAD solids enter from opposite sides of the bridge plate; no mesh is cut or substituted.

limitations: Sampled source poses; interpolation does not imply measured engineering time.
